Home > PRIN > PRIN 2

PRIN 2.1 The Principles

PRIN 2.1.1 R 01/04/2013

The Principles

1 IntegrityA firm must conduct its business with integrity.
2 Skill, care and diligenceA firm must conduct its business with due skill, care and diligence.
12 Consumer DutyA firm must act to deliver good outcomes for retail customers.

PRIN 2.1.2 G 31/07/2023

The Principles are a general statement of the fundamental obligations of firms under the regulatory system.

PRIN 2.1.3 R 31/07/2023

Principle 12 applies to a firm in relation to retail market business.

PRIN 2.2 Application of the Principles

PRIN 2.2.1 G 01/04/2013

PRIN 3 sets out the application of the Principles.
